## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] Existing tests pass.
- [ ] User-facing behavior or limitations are documented.
- [ ] No source documents, generated outputs, models, secrets, credentials, or personal paths are included.
- [ ] OCR behavior and dependencies are unchanged unless the pull request explains why a change is required.
